system.description:
With something in your hands — a sword, a stick, a set of nunchaku, even a chair — you are a deadly fighter, able to put any weapon to damaging effect.

Expend Melee for retests in hand-to-hand combat when using a close-combat weapon. Certain weapons function best when wielded by a character with the Melee Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
